## Design

### 2026-10-06 – I decided to start by doing what I thought was going to be simple: downloading the prerequisites. My hope was to finish designing the schematic, but I couldn't due to a huge obstacle. I've tried to do

**3h**

I decided to start by doing what I thought was going to be simple: downloading the prerequisites. My hope was to finish designing the schematic, but I couldn't due to a huge obstacle. I've tried to do hack club projects before, so I had KiCad installed on my RPI. However, there was a huge issue: the care package's symbols were made in KiCad version 10, whilie I had v9. All of RPI's installers are slow at updating applications, so when I tried Recommended Software, Pi-Apps and even the terminal, nothing worked.

Picture of error:
![20261006_03h45m02s_grim](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KQCyBcYn6IogPFBuWHZ5GfGedGnxxuWs/4f4e17db66c7a7b52e145ba98a25ed813ef0096ce64ffc3712a4a32c4e45863c.png)

Then, I came across the only installer software that had version 10 of KiCad: Flatpak. For those who don't know, Flatpak is sort of a more complicated version of .exe files. When I tried to install KiCad, It said I didn't have the GPG key, so I spent a long time trying to manually install it. However, at the end, I managed to download KiCad v10.

Picture of some terminal work:
![20261006_054122_grim](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KQCyBcYn6IogPFBuWHZ5GfGedGnxxuWs/8820c5c6677ff8595f061c204e772059ee84802476a8dd2344d05a974cfc8378.png)

Importing .sym file:
![20261006_055101_grim](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KQCyBcYn6IogPFBuWHZ5GfGedGnxxuWs/2d1cb5e7dff55d81e16f60431f7d749c62ba22b24c08068fd111fa2b3b0a78bb.png)

I decided to choose a BME280 for my DHT11 Alternative. It has Barometric pressure readings. Here is a bit of the wiring:
![20261006_185641_grim](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/KQCyBcYn6IogPFBuWHZ5GfGedGnxxuWs/c78ac6943714de0706eb182dd14f18167d09b1759c85ade3769b9bc397d10582.webp)

I hope to finish the rest of the schematic today...
